messages:
monica: quick plan note - launching a tiny refapp + 12-min micro-lab next Thu. primary goals: 180 visits, 70 GH stars, 60 signups. need owners: launch post (blog + hn), bench one-pager, 12-min demo script, RSVP + TY email, and inbound routing. who takes which?

dave: I can own the bench one-pager and the little chart. plan: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated. will include a 1-line methods: 512 tokens, batch=4.

leo: RSVP + thank-you flow is mine. propose form fields: name, email, company_size, job_title, use_case. add utm params: utm_source=microlab, utm_campaign=ref-lab-1. TZ-aware 1-click calendar add. will map big leads to AE queue.

claire: Ill draft the blog + HN blurb and three hero copy variants (technical, outcome, playful). will include a tiny how-to guide and the GH quickstart link.

monica: inbound routing rule suggestion: if company_size>=100 or job_title contains "platform|infra" -> AE; else SDR nurture. tag leads with "ref:microlab" and capture `use_case`.

dave: bench ETA tomorrow AM. sharing raw numbers + PNG to ticket when ready. will keep the slide simple.

leo: routing detail: if job_title blank, try LinkedIn lookup via zap; if lookup fails, tag `role:unknown`. also capture `utm_medium`.

claire: A/B test plan for hero: run 48h, KPI CTR->RSVP >= 2.5%. variants labelled `copy/a`, `copy/b`, `copy/c`.

notify-bot: Ticket MK-6012 created: "Microlab RefApp launch checklist" assigned: monica, dave, leo, claire. Reminder set 48h before launch.

monica: demo script note: keep under 12m. show quick setup, 90s long-context example, then bench slide + 30s wrap. keep slides to 3.

dave: will post the tiny bench table to the ticket and attach png.

leo: will share Zap blueprint and the thank-you email copy.

claire: will upload blog drafts and hero images into the ticket.

monica: booked 20m prep Mon 09:15 PT. confirm by EOD if youre good with ownership. :rocket:
